scenario: The ego vehicle emergency brakes and swerves right to avoid a rear-end collision with a lead sedan that stops abruptly on a crosswalk, resulting in a minor impact.

ego.behavior: The car travels forward, emergency brakes, and swerves right to avoid colliding with the stopped lead vehicle ahead.

adversarials.behavior: The sedan travels slowly ahead of the ego vehicle, stops abruptly on the crosswalk, and simultaneously drifts right into the ego's swerve path, resulting in minor contact.

spatial_relation: The ego vehicle follows a lead sedan on a straight two-lane road approaching a crosswalk; the lead sedan stops on the crosswalk while the ego attempts to pass on the right.
requirements_and_restrictions: The scenario involves an emergency braking event triggered by the lead sedan's sudden stop on the crosswalk; the scenario terminates after the minor impact occurs.

road_side_structures.position: Positioned on the left side of the road near the crosswalk area.
Positioned on the right side of the road beyond the crosswalk.

reasoning_chain: 1. Actors: The ego is the camera-host vehicle from the dashboard perspective; the lead sedan is the sole adversarial. 2. Chronology: Initially, ego follows sedan at distance on two-lane road. Midpoint, sedan brake lights illuminate and it stops on crosswalk. Ending, ego swerves right but sedan drifts right, causing minor impact. 3. Evidence: Sedan's brake lights activate before stopping; its position shifts rightward while stopped; ego's rightward trajectory brings it alongside the drifting sedan.
